rubric.notes: Four original portraits remain: spring waterfall, ornate amber manor, cyan submerged garden and sculpted basalt coast. Atmospheric depth and visual cohesion are unchanged; Host has been removed as requested.

The corrected row contains only New, Resume, Load Game and Browse at left edges 139, 340, 541, 742; top 211; width 197; height 298; gap 4 at 1280x720. Resume is selected initially. Actual creature remains behind every card, with more of its right-side shoulder and torso visible after removing Host.

Card scrims and text shadows preserve the prior readability improvements. Supporting copy remains very small at 1280px, consistent with the reference scale. Actual model rendering does not obscure menu labels.

Actual animated GLB remains correctly framed behind all four cards. Crown, eye, orbital rings, shoulder, outer arm, hands and robe establish the intended silhouette. Removing Host reveals more of the torso and shoulder without covering menu labels. Outer hand and lower robe cropping remain intentional framing choices.

Corrected exposure preserves crown and robe detail and fits the model into the warm gold/teal atmosphere. Model hair and skin still read more mint and diffusely lit than the darker illustrated reference; some material appearance differences belong to the supplied asset.

Teal cores and soft halos surround the actual model without masking the cards. Named Idle animation and motion-preference behavior are supported by artifacts/model-verification.json; still-image visual review does not independently measure animation quality.
